from queueing import Queue


def test_basic_claim_and_renew_and_complete():
    q = Queue()
    q.add("j1")
    # initial claim
    lease = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=5)
    assert lease is not None, "claim should return a lease"
    assert lease["job_id"] == "j1"
    assert lease["worker"] == "w1"
    assert lease["token"] is not None

    # second claim should return None (no eligible jobs)
    lease2 = q.claim("w2", now=10, ttl=5)
    assert lease2 is None, "second claim should return None"

    # renew should succeed
    ok = q.renew(lease, now=12, ttl=5)
    assert ok is True, "renew should return True"
    # expiry should now be 17
    job = q._jobs["j1"]
    assert job["expiry"] == 17, f"expected expiry 17, got {job['expiry']}"

    # complete should succeed
    ok2 = q.complete(lease, now=20)
    assert ok2 is True, "complete should return True"
    job = q._jobs["j1"]
    assert job["state"] == "completed", f"expected completed, got {job['state']}"

    # after complete, claim should return None
    lease3 = q.claim("w3", now=20, ttl=5)
    assert lease3 is None, "claim after complete should return None"


def test_eligible_running_jobs_reclaim():
    q = Queue()
    q.add("j1")
    lease = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=5)
    # now time advances past expiry
    lease2 = q.claim("w2", now=20, ttl=5)
    assert lease2 is not None, "reclaim of expired running job should succeed"
    assert lease2["job_id"] == "j1"
    assert lease2["worker"] == "w2"
    assert lease2["token"] != lease["token"], "new claim must get a new token"

    # renew with old token should fail
    ok = q.renew(lease, now=25, ttl=5)
    assert ok is False, "renew with old/claimed-out token should fail"

    # complete with old token should fail
    ok2 = q.complete(lease, now=25)
    assert ok2 is False, "complete with old/claimed-out token should fail"


def test_ttl_must_be_positive():
    q = Queue()
    q.add("j1")
    lease = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=0)
    assert lease is None, "claim with ttl=0 should return None"
    lease = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=-1)
    assert lease is None, "claim with ttl<0 should return None"


def test_token_is_unique_per_claim():
    q = Queue()
    q.add("j1")
    l1 = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=5)
    l2 = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=5)
    assert l1 is not None and l2 is not None
    assert l1["token"] != l2["token"], "each claim must get a new unique token"

    # reclaim by same worker also gets new token
    l3 = q.claim("w1", now=20, ttl=5)
    assert l3 is not None
    assert l3["token"] != l1["token"], "reclaim by same worker must also get new token"


def test_caller_mutation_protection():
    q = Queue()
    q.add("j1")
    lease = q.claim("w1", now=10, ttl=5)
    # make a copy and mutate it; internal state should be untouched
    lease_copy = dict(lease)
    lease_copy["worker"] = "hacker"
    lease_copy["job_id"] = "j_hacked"
    # internal state must be unchanged
    job = q._jobs["j1"]
    assert job["job_id"] == "j1", f"job_id should remain j1, got {job['job_id']}"
    assert job["worker"] == "w1", f"worker should remain w1, got {job['worker']}"


def test_class_signatures_preserved():

    assert hasattr(q, "complete") and callable(q.complete)
